result.summary: The main visual defect is horizontal overflow: multiple horizontally scrolling sections are clipped at the right edge, leaving partial chips and restaurant cards visible. The page otherwise appears structurally intact.

issues.description: The category chip row overflows the viewport on the right, showing a cut-off next chip with no clear trailing padding or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Implement intentional horizontal scrolling with consistent end padding and a visible affordance, or constrain/wrap the category chips so no item is partially clipped.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel extends beyond the right edge and cuts off the third restaurant card, including its image, title, and delivery information.
issues.suggestion: Use a properly padded horizontal carousel with full-card snap positions, or resize cards so the intended layout does not leave restaurant content abruptly truncated.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' list is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, so its content cannot be fully viewed in the captured viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding above the fixed navigation bar so the last visible card can scroll fully clear of it.
